description: Land Acquisition - Batakettara, North, Kesbewa D/S Division. Colombo District. Thumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division. Colombo District. (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes (construction of a Samurdhi Community Based Bank and Divisional Secretary Quarters), including detailed descriptions of the land, locations, extents, and procedures for compensation claims. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land acquisition, property descriptions, and land-related administrative procedures.
